entries.text: This is the entrance to Blueberry Academy.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_01

entries.text: Our school puts a great deal of emphasis on the\nart of Pokémon battling.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_02

entries.text: We hold official matches on this central court\nright here at the entrance—and any student can\r\nfreely utilize this court if it’s not otherwise in use.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_03

entries.text: I think it’s safe to say that you’ll be battling more\nhere than in any other school![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_04

entries.text: Exactly! Couldn’t have said it better myself![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_headbb_01

entries.text: Director Cyrano... I think perhaps it’s fine if you\njust leave the tour to me.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_05

entries.text: Still...it’s really relaxing here, with the sea breeze\nblowing over you. Even when no one is battling,\r\nyou often see students lazing about in the stands.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_06

entries.text: Oh, oh, oh! And there’s one other quality of our\nschool that you’ll likely find very surprising![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_07

entries.text: Wild Pokémon sometimes Terastallize here![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_08

entries.text: Really!
entries.label: sdc02_0050_select_01

entries.text: Yeah...?
entries.label: sdc02_0050_select_02

entries.text: Oh. I suppose that’s not anything special to\nsomeone from Paldea, is it?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_09

entries.text: The Terastal phenomenon was first discovered\nin the Paldea region, after all.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_headbb_02

entries.text:
But we’ve taken things a step further than you
and your Tera Orbs.\c
We’ve developed some neat tech ourselves—
something that lets us control the Terastal
phenomenon on our own turf![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_headbb_03

entries.text: I bet that piques your interest, doesn’t it?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_headbb_04

entries.text: Um, sir, I think it will be easier to understand\nhow all that works after we go to the lower level.\r\nIf you could put a little pin in that thought?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_10

entries.text: Always thinking ahead—that’s our Lacey![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_headbb_05

entries.text: Oh! You know what? I think it’d be great if the\ntwo of you had a battle![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_headbb_06

entries.text: Wha—?! Right now?![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_11

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Why not? I’d like to see what
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]
here
is
capable
of.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_headbb_07

entries.text:
And our Lacey is a member of the Elite Four in
the League Club we have going here.\c
To say nothing of the influence of her father—
one of the Unova region’s famed Gym Leaders!
I bet you’ll learn a thing or two![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_headbb_08

entries.text: Oh, I wish you wouldn’t go spreading personal\ninformation without asking first![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_12

entries.text: It’s just not right![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_13

entries.text: Give me a good show now, you two![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_headbb_10

entries.text:
I’m sorry, but...there’s no negotiating with
Director Cyrano once he gets an idea in his head.\c
There’s no way that he’ll move on with the tour
until we’ve given him his battle.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_14

entries.text: Besides, I have to admit I’m a little excited\nmyself at the chance to battle you![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_15

entries.text:
Here at Blueberry Academy, we tend to go for
Double Battles.\c
Let’s give one a try to get to know each other
a little better![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_16

entries.text:
Spectacular! You really are quite skilled.\c
And the way you Terastallized your Pokémon—
I can see that living in the home of the Terastal
phenomenon taught you much.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_17

entries.text:
Spectacular! You really are quite skilled.\c
I wish I could have seen you Terastallize one
of your Pokémon, though. I’d love to see how
someone from Paldea does it![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_18

entries.text: I’m relieved I could pull out a win... It was a\npositively white-hot battle, after all![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_19

entries.text: The students here at Blueberry Academy were\nonly recently issued Tera Orbs, so I hope you’ll\r\nbe able to teach us more about them.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_20

entries.text: Well done to the both of you! You really battled\nit out Blueberry-style.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_headbb_11

entries.text: Speaking of style...\c\nI forgot I had a uniform for you! You’ll feel like\nyou fit right in as soon as you’re dressing the part![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_headbb_12

entries.text: It suits you beautifully![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_25

entries.text: Now that’s what I call fashion! Oh, and you can\ntake this as well.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_headbb_14

entries.text: That should give you a few more options when\nyou visit shops and salons and such in Paldea![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_headbb_15

entries.text: Now that you look the part—and hopefully feel\nit too—why don’t we head into the school?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_21

entries.text: You can pick where you want to go from the\ngates over there.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_22

entries.text: Come on! I can show you the pride of Blueberry\nAcademy: our world-famous [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Terarium[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_23

entries.text: We should visit the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Terarium [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]next! Just select\nit at the gate, and we’ll be off.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_fairybb_24

entries.text: You’re a strong one. Excadrill is a lot speedier\nthan it looks, but you handled yourself well![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0050_headbb_13
